source_consistency.finding: At the sampled cell, short-period daily responses disagree with the saved long-period response. On two wet dates, the saved value is exactly 24 times the short-period daily value. The 24 hourly values for 2024-03-02 sum to the short-period daily value. This is request-period-dependent source inconsistency, not an established correction factor for all data.

feature_coverage_audit.next_step: Recollect rainfall in validated shorter date ranges, independently compare daily totals with hourly values on multiple cells/years and flood events, then recompute the catchment series. Do not divide every saved value by 24 without checking. Collect other chosen historical features over the common 2016-03-01 to 2024-12-19 period.

quality.policy: WAPDA is the baseline source. Keep all daily dates and source values. Blank modeling values and exclude all unresolved zeros or disagreements. Never average sources, impute gaps, or transfer FFD times onto WAPDA dates. Eligibility is for date-level research only, not an assertion of certified hydrological accuracy or operational availability.
quality.training_window_rule: Require consecutive calendar dates and eligible observations throughout each input window and all 15 target days; do not drop missing dates and join across gaps. Chronological split selection remains to be implemented before training.

rainfall_report.source_transition: POWER may append GEOS-IT recent estimates to MERRA2. Per-date source transition is not exposed in these responses; preserve the source headers and retrieval date.
rainfall_report.area_method: Densify WGS84 edges to at most 0.005 degrees, project boundary and native cell footprints into WGS84 Lambert azimuthal equal-area centered at 33 N, 76 E, and intersect. Weight = intersection area / full catchment area.
rainfall_report.missing_value_policy: Full-catchment daily mean is blank if any required grid value is missing. No interpolation or renormalization over available cells.
rainfall_report.time_standard: UTC; each period is [00:00, next 00:00), equivalent to [05:00, next 05:00) Pakistan time.
rainfall_report.forecast_use: Use only completed periods available by issue time. Retrospective reanalysis is not an archived weather forecast or proof of historical operational availability. Do not use a full day's value at 06:00 Pakistan on that same date.

outlet.network_check_basis: Network intersects the +/-0.005 degree rounding box implied by two-decimal station coordinates, rather than assuming survey precision.

rainfall_grid_coverage.method: Intersect native cell footprints, not grid centers or the requested rectangle, with the catchment. WGS84 geodesic areas.
rainfall_grid_coverage.action: Full catchment is covered; no spatial grid extension is required.

limitations: Model-derived hydrological boundary; not a surveyed or WAPDA/PMD-issued polygon.
Literature area agreement is a consistency check, not independent field verification.
Input coordinate is published to two decimal degrees. A nearby test gives an identical polygon; the exact service snap point is not exposed.
Provider documents MERIT-Hydro/MERIT-Basins, but the live API does not expose exact underlying dataset/software versions.
Catchment follows modeled topographic drainage and does not encode time-varying canal transfers, dam operations, or groundwater exchanges.

rainfall_screening.rule: Advisory review screen for catchment means >=100 mm/day; not an official flood or invalid-data threshold. Source values are unchanged.
